integration.note: Later Android Parcel changes do not modify the qualified x86 code or dependency pin. Both SDK libraries and source suites were rebuilt/retested after integration. Paging test binaries remained byte-identical; their recorded CPU checks retain their actual earlier qualified commit.

limitations: CPU comparisons cover this Intel hybrid host with POPCNT/LZCNT/BMI1/ADX enabled. Feature-disabled BSR/BSF aliases and #UD priority have independent software-contract checks, not physical qualification on a processor missing those features.
Only architecturally undefined LZCNT/TZCNT OF/SF/AF/PF come from an independent host probe. Defined register values and CF/ZF are never imported from the compared protected CPU run.
Original protected byte execution and runtime-backed generated C are the new boundary. Ordinary LLVM/NeverC integer lowering already existed; no compiler intrinsic or native ISA emission is changed.
The generated-C i386 object lane is compile-only; runtime comparisons use Linux x64. Other profiles, unsupported encodings and state banks remain explicit refusals.
